name: Bumble and bumble

lead: Bumble and bumble is a hair salon and hair-care brand founded in New York in 1977 by hairdresser Michael Gordon. Its products include styling and finishing items used to add texture, hold and shape to a haircut.

The appearance payoff is the usual one for styling products: they let hair sit in the intended shape through the day and show off a cut. The company is owned by Estee Lauder Companies, and its products are sold in beauty retailers.

paras: Users apply styling products to damp or dry hair and then shape it, with different formats for hold, texture or shine. Results last until the next wash.
As with other styling products, scalp or skin irritation is possible in people sensitive to ingredients. Product labels carry usage advice.

chain: Cut keeps its shape through the day
angle.text: Styling products change how the hair looks while they are on it: texture, volume and hold. Users reach for them to make a haircut look more polished.

lead: Bumble and bumble is a hair salon and hair-care company founded in 1977 by hairdresser and entrepreneur Michael Gordon. It runs a flagship salon in New York City, and since 2000 it has been owned by Estee Lauder Companies, one of that group's brands [1].
People use its styling products to shape and finish hair so a cut looks deliberate and keeps its form. By 2017 the products were stocked in Ulta Beauty stores [1].
No clinical studies of the brand's products were identified.

paras: Michael Gordon founded the company in 1977. A 2000 New York Post article reported its purchase by Estee Lauder Companies, and the page notes a 2012 New York Times report about the founder and tax authorities [1]. The brand operates one flagship salon in New York City [1].
Hair styling is a common low-cost area of appearance work, and salon-brand products are one of many options people compare for hold and finish.
